gaps.description: The dependency chain from DPC++ to buffer<int> is only partially documented. While DPC++ explicitly depends on queue, and buffer<int> implicitly depends on queue, there is no direct or indirect documentation linking DPC++ to buffer<int> through the chain. This creates a gap where the full prerequisite chain remains unresolved without additional context.
gaps.why_rag_fails: The direct link between DPC++ and buffer<int> is not explicitly stated in the document. Retrieval systems cannot infer the full chain without explicit documentation of the connection between DPC++ and buffer<int>, even though their dependencies are indirectly related through queue.
